prep. To; unto; towards; -- used of material objects.
prep. To; up to; till; before; -- used of time; as, he staid
   until evening; he will not come back until the end of the month.
conj. As far as; to the place or degree that; especially, up to
   the time that; till. See Till, conj.

translation: prep. 在...之上, 迫近, 紧接着
definition: prep. On; -- used in all the senses of that word, with which it\n   is interchangeable.

translation: adv. 通常, 大抵
definition: r under normal conditions

translation: n. 多样, 种类, 变种, 杂耍\n[化] 变种
definition: n. (biology) a taxonomic category consisting of members of a species that differ from others of the same species in minor but heritable characteristics\nn. a difference that is usually pleasant

translation: a. 垂直的, 直立的\n[医] 垂直的, 顶的, 头顶的
definition:
n. something that is oriented vertically
a. at right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line
a. relating to or involving all stages of a business from production to distribution
s. of or relating to different levels in a hierarchy (as levels of social class or income group)

translation: n. 杰出人物\na. 有价值的, 可敬的, 值得的
definition: n. an important, honorable person (word is often used humorously)\na. having worth or merit or value; being honorable or admirable\ns. having qualities or abilities that merit recognition in some way

translation: n. 年代；岁月；年；年龄
definition:
n a late time of life
n a prolonged period of time
n the time during which someone's life continues
n a period of time containing 365 (or 366) days
n a period of time occupying a regular part of a calendar year that is used for some particular activity
n the period of time that it takes for a planet (as, e.g., Earth or Mars) to make a complete revolution around the sun
n a body of students who graduate together
